deviations.description: Hand-edit only the two roadmap entries in index-entries.json, never run --write
deviations.reason: deploy-headless.sh's own inline verify step runs generate-context-line-counts.sh --write automatically as a side effect every time it deploys -- an R3 scenario the plan anticipated in principle but not as something THIS task's own gate-testing would repeatedly trigger. Each of three deploy-headless.sh invocations this phase needed (to get a fresh deployed tree for gate testing) re-dirtied index-entries.json with several sibling entries' corrections on top of mine. Resolved every time by programmatically reconciling the file against the git-committed baseline, re-applying only the two intended entries, verified via git diff --stat showing exactly 16 lines changed immediately before every commit.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- repeated reconciliation against an externally-dirtied file, not a one-time hand-edit as the plan phrased it)*
